description: A wide stone stair descends into the hush, its steps thick with soft green moss that feels like velvet underfoot. The river below moves so slowly it looks like a single, long breath held by the world. Paper lanterns float gently on the surface, their warm glow turning the water into a pool of liquid amber.

objects.name: mossy river stone
objects.seed: a smooth, rounded stone half-buried in the moss, cool to the touch and heavy with the quiet weight of a thousand paused seconds

objects.name: folded paper hour
objects.seed: a small square of cream paper resting on a drift of moss, marked with a tiny brass tick and a note written in a careful, fading hand

phrase: a mossy stair down to a slow river
room_seed: a slow river of liquid time flows down a mossy stone stair, its surface holding the soft amber light of dusk lanterns while deep blue shadows gather in the folds of the water
title: The Mossy River
